# Contributing to Translate It!

Thanks for your interest in contributing! You can help with code, documentation, bug reports, ideas, and more. The [public roadmap](https://github.com/orgs/Translate-It-App/projects/2) shows what is planned and in progress.

1. **Find work:** Browse [good first issues](https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20is%3Aopen%20label%3A%22good%20first%20issue%22), the [roadmap](https://github.com/orgs/Translate-It-App/projects/2), and [open Issues](https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/issues). Check for existing or assigned work before starting.
2. **Share an idea or report a bug:** Use [Discussions](https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/discussions) for early ideas and questions; use [Issues](https://github.com/Translate-It-App/Translate-It/issues) for actionable bugs and feature requests. Small independent fixes can go directly to a pull request.
3. **Get started:** Coordinate substantial work on its Issue before implementation, then submit a pull request with a clear summary, relevant Issue links, and the validation you ran. Feature requests do not need prior approval.

See the [full contributing guide](../docs/guides/CONTRIBUTING.md) for coordination details, development setup, builds, testing, and validation. Sensitive security reports should be made privately as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
